blocks.text: Brace yourselves, Filipino Haeiness. Local organizers of South Korean actor Jung Hae-in’s Manila stop has just announced the venue and price tickets for his meet-and-greet with fans. According to Karpos, local promoter, Jung’s concert will be held at the PICC Plenary Hall in Pasay City on Sunday, January 31, 2027, at 8:00 p.m. The show is part of his “Meet Me There” concert series covering a number of cities across the globe.
